items.prompt: Add magic e to cap. What word do you get?
hints: Magic e goes at the end of the word.
It makes the a say its name.
Write cap, add e and read it.
items.explanation: Cap plus e is cape. The e makes the a say its name.

options.why: That is the word before we add e.
Cop has a different vowel.
Cup has a different vowel.

figure.alt: A kite flying in the sky.

hints: Say the picture name.
Listen to the i. Is it long or short?
A long i in a short word often needs magic e.
items.explanation: Kite has a long i, so it needs magic e: k, i, t, e.

options.why: A kit is a set of things. Add e to make the i say its name.
Cut has a short u sound.
Cat has a short a sound.

items.prompt: Match each word to its magic e partner.
hints: Each pair is the same word, plus e.
Look for the same first letters.
Start with hop. Find hop with an e.
items.explanation: Adding e changes the vowel sound: hop to hope, pin to pine, tub to tube, man to mane.

items.prompt: Short vowel or long vowel? Sort the words.
hints: Look at the end of each word.
Magic e makes the vowel say its name.
Start with bike. Does it end with e?
items.explanation: Bike, home and cute have magic e and a long vowel. Big, hot and cut have a short vowel.

items.prompt: Write the word for this picture.
hints: Say the word slowly.
The o says its name.
Write b, o, n, then think about the end.
items.explanation: Bone has a long o, so it needs magic e: b, o, n, e.

hints: Say cake slowly.
Rhyming words end with the same sound.
Look for a word that also ends with a, k, e.
items.explanation: Snake and cake rhyme. Both end with ake.

options.why: Back has a short a sound.
Cook ends with a different sound.
Sack has a short a sound.

items.prompt: Which word makes the sentence right? 'I ___ my bike to school.'
hints: Read the sentence with each word.
What do you do on a bike?
The word has a long i sound.
items.explanation: We ride a bike. Ride has a long i, so it ends with magic e.

options.why: Rid means to get rid of something. Add e for the long i.
Red is a colour.
A rod is a long stick.

items.prompt: Add magic e to tap. Write the new word.
hints: Magic e goes on the end.
The a will say its name.
Write tap, then add one letter.
items.explanation: Tap plus e is tape, like sticky tape.

items.prompt: Choose all the words where magic e makes a long vowel.
hints: Three words are right.
Some words end in e, but the vowel stays short.
Say each word. Does the vowel say its name?
items.explanation: Home, plane and flute have long vowels made by magic e. Have ends in e, but its a is short.

options.why: Have ends in e, but the a does not say its name.
Hop has no magic e.

items.prompt: What does the magic e do in tube?
hints: Say tub, then say tube.
Listen to the u in each word.
Is the e at the end loud or silent?
items.explanation: The magic e is silent. It makes the u say its name, so tub becomes tube.

options.text: It makes the word mean more than one.
options.why: More than one is shown with s or es.

options.text: It makes the u say its name.
It makes an e sound at the end.
options.why: The e at the end is silent.

options.text: It makes the word a question.
options.why: Questions need a question mark.

items.prompt: Put the words in order to make a sentence.
hints: Start with the word that has a capital letter.
The describing word comes before the naming word.
End with the word that has a full stop.
items.explanation: The white kite flies high. White and kite both have magic e.

items.prompt: Change one letter in line. Make the name of a green fruit.
hints: Keep l, i and e the same.
Change the n to another letter.
The fruit is small, green and sour.
items.explanation: Line becomes lime when n changes to m. A lime is a small green fruit.

items.prompt: Which word has a magic e?
hints: All four words end in e.
Magic e makes the vowel say its name.
Say each word. Which vowel is long?
items.explanation: In bone, the o says its name, so the e is magic. Give, come and have end in e, but their vowels are short.

options.why: Give ends in e, but the i is short.
Come ends in e, but the o does not say its name.
Have ends in e, but the a is short.

hints: Check every word.
Two words in the sentence need magic e.
Hope means you wish for something.
items.explanation: Hope and lake both have long vowels, so both end in magic e.

options.text: I hop we can swim in the lak.
options.why: Hope and lake both need magic e.

options.text: I hope we can swim in the lak.
options.why: Lake needs magic e.

options.text: I hop we can swim in the lake.
options.why: Hope needs magic e here.

options.text: I hope we can swim in the lake.

items.prompt: Write the opposite of early. It ends with magic e.
hints: Early means before the right time.
The opposite means after the right time.
The word rhymes with gate.
items.explanation: Late is the opposite of early. It is spelt l, a, t, e.

items.prompt: Take the magic e off note. Then change o to u. What word is it?
hints: Do it one step at a time.
Note without e is a short word.
Now swap the o for a u and read it.
items.explanation: Note without e is not. Not with u instead of o is nut.

options.why: Check the vowel: o changes to u.
That is the word before you change o to u.
The e was taken away.

items.prompt: Which word makes a new word when you add magic e?
hints: Add e to each word and say it.
Listen for a real word with a long vowel.
Which one becomes something you can fly?
items.explanation: Kit plus e makes kite. The others do not make real words.

options.why: Dog plus e is not a word you would use.
Bed plus e is not a word you would use.
Cup plus e is not a word.

items.prompt: Which word has a long a sound?
hints: Long a says its name.
Look at the end of each word.
Which word has a magic e?
items.explanation: Gate has a magic e, so the a says its name.

options.why: Gap has a short a.
Get has a short e.
Got has a short o.
